trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) = 0 AND p.position <> 'Backcourt' AND t.founded_year <> '1989' RETURN t.team_name AS col1, AVG(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
